  • Comfort
  • Protection
  • Style

Category 1: Comfort.

Hoodies win, hands down. I can sleep while wearing a hoodie, very easily. I can use a hoodie as a fucking blanket if I want to. There is no contest.

Category 2: Protection

Jackets win. Hoodies kinda suck in the rain, as they are made of cotton/polyester for the most part. Jackets can be made of nylon or leather or a multitude of more water-resistant materials. Also, you can wear a hat with a jacket without looking like a massive douche.

Regardless of destination:

  • ensure that you have skills that the country prizes in the job market, or otherwise are moving to study exactly that.

  • be quick to engage in group activities and make local connections that will teach you important information about the place.

  • ensure that the citizens in the city/country off destination are okay enough with foreigners, or at least your kind of foreigner.

  • ensure that even if the country is remarkably pleasant to visit, it's immigration policy won't screw you over.

  • ensure it's not at war with the USA nor with Russia nor with China.
